channelUrls.description: Public YouTube channel URLs, handles, or channel IDs.
channelUrls.title: Channel URLs

includeLinks.description: Include external links that YouTube exposes on the public About page.
includeLinks.title: Include public external links

includePlaylists.description: Add public playlist rows from the channel Playlists tab to the profile row. Use the dedicated playlist actor for larger catalogs.
includePlaylists.title: Include public playlists

includePostComments.description: Include comments and exposed replies nested inside combined Community Posts rows when YouTube returns them publicly.
includePostComments.title: Include post comments

includePosts.description: Add public Community Posts rows, including exposed media and polls, to the profile row. Use the dedicated posts actor for larger catalogs.
includePosts.title: Include community posts

market.description: Country code used for the public localized YouTube page.
market.title: Market

maxPlaylists.description: Maximum public playlist rows to nest in each combined profile row when includePlaylists is enabled.
maxPlaylists.title: Maximum combined playlists

maxPostComments.description: Maximum public comments and replies to retain inside each combined post when includePostComments is enabled.
maxPostComments.title: Maximum comments per post

maxPosts.description: Maximum public Community Posts rows to nest in each combined profile row when includePosts is enabled.
maxPosts.title: Maximum combined posts
